scoring_judgment_guidance: Score this session with the rubric below, not against a fixed answer key — a design, code, or debugging task legitimately has more than one valid solution. Record the level reached on each dimension with one specific reason drawn from the actual submission. Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.

protected_task.decisive_resolution: Accept multiple defensible responses. A passing response has three traceable evidence links, one feasible revision or decision, one observable check, and one honest limitation; reject claims that require facts outside the package.
protected_task.prohibited_shortcut: Do not give the learner a completed evidence map, selected decision, or finished design before independent evidence is submitted.

accepted_evidence_model: Each claim cites N1–N5 and stays within what that label supports.
The revision addresses N5 while continuing to respect N1 and N2.

fresh_mastery_check.decisive_resolution: Accept multiple responses that satisfy all four evidence conditions; no single wording, layout, or decision is required.

remediation_authority.selection_rule: Choose the smallest alternate route from observable evidence; do not repeat the original task or expose its protected resolution.
remediation_authority.mastery_reconsideration: Reconsider mastery only from the fresh independent record under the same criteria. A worked or guided response is instruction, not mastery evidence.

mastery_rule: Do not mark mastery from one answer. Use digital artifact, algorithm or code, commit or test log, source record, design explanation, and safe-use reflection; require accurate independent evidence and successful transfer or retrieval on at least two occasions when feasible.

mastery_interpretation.secure: At least 85% with accurate independent application and adequate evidence and reasoning.
mastery_interpretation.developing: 70–84% or inconsistent explanation; assign targeted review and a fresh transfer check.
mastery_interpretation.not_yet: Below 70% or a missing prerequisite; reteach the smallest gap and reassess with new evidence.
mastery_interpretation.rule: A unit score is one evidence source, not the sole basis for long-term mastery.

unit_assessment_reference.note: This lesson is one session inside the unit; the unit assessment record above is the summative instrument, and this lesson rubric scores only this session's evidence.

remediation_plan: Reteaching for entities attributes and relationships follows the signal actually observed, not a fixed script. If the signal is "prerequisite gap": Return to the smallest prerequisite needed for entities attributes and relationships, model it in a concrete or text-only representation, then retry one fresh item. If the signal is "procedure without understanding": Ask the learner to explain or represent why the approach to entities attributes and relationships works before continuing. If the signal is "correct but low confidence": Confirm the reasoning specifically, offer one varied example of entities attributes and relationships, and avoid unnecessary remediation. If the signal is "repeated error pattern": Name the observable pattern neutrally, contrast it with a worked example, and schedule a short same-day or next-session review. If the signal is "requests the answer to graded work": Explain the concept, ask a diagnostic question, or help isolate the defect. Do not supply the graded artifact, solution code, or finished creative work. If the signal is "mastery evidence": Require accurate independent application plus explanation on a later or different occasion before marking entities attributes and relationships mastered. Re-check with one fresh item of the same kind before moving on, and record which signal was seen so the pattern is visible across the unit rather than treated as a one-off.
extension_plan: Apply entities attributes and relationships under a new constraint, compare two approaches or perspectives, or explain the idea to someone else using an original example. Treat this as optional depth on entities attributes and relationships rather than extra volume: one harder case done well beats three more of the same. Extension work stays inside the same sandbox rules — no real credentials and no live external systems. Extension work is never required to reach mastery and must not be assigned as a penalty.
accommodation_note: Access supports may change format, pacing, quantity, setting, or response mode without changing the standard being assessed.
accessibility_options: Provide readable text plus optional audio or read-aloud support; no voice feature is required.
Chunk directions into one action at a time and show a worked example or model.
Offer reduced-copying, extended-time, hidden-timer, movement-break, and low-distraction options.
Use captions, alt text, high-contrast print, keyboard access, and text-only fallbacks for media.
For any multi-session project, supply a written milestone plan, checkpoint dates, and a task breakdown, so executive-function load is not silently part of what is being assessed.

Adjust quantity, pacing, representation, or response mode while holding the target constant. Where the target names a specific skill, change how it is evidenced rather than substituting a different skill.
Accept typed, handwritten, spoken, diagrammed, or demonstrated responses; where code is the target, accept pseudocode, block-based, or annotated-trace evidence.
Provide screen-reader-compatible editors, adjustable font and contrast, keyboard-only workflows, and an offline paper-and-trace route for every programming task.
task_accessibility_provisions: Provide a screen-reader-compatible editor, adjustable font size and contrast, and a complete keyboard-only workflow. An offline paper-and-trace route is available for every task here and is scored identically to an on-screen one.
Breaks, extended time, a hidden timer, reduced copying, and a low-distraction setting are available on request and never reduce the score.
parent_or_guardian_visibility: Share the lesson target, completion state, evidence type, and next instructional step. Do not expose raw private reflections, raw answers, recordings, or diagnosis language. For safety-critical tasks, record only the needed guardian confirmation.

safety_and_privacy.note: No real credential, live external system, production account, or real personal data is used anywhere in this session; all values are fictional or sandboxed and no live system may be probed or accessed.
